definitions.explanation: Money or goods given voluntarily to a charity, organization, or cause.

examples.japanese: {被災者|ひさいしゃ}に{寄付|きふ}をした。
examples.english: I made a donation to the disaster victims.

examples.japanese: 1{万円|まんえん}を{寄付|きふ}する。
{寄付|きふ}{金|きん}を{集|あつ}める。

notes:
{寄付|きふ} refers to voluntary giving to charities or causes.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {寄付|きふ}する (to donate)
- {寄付|きふ}を{する|募る} (to solicit donations)
- 〜に{寄付|きふ}する (to donate to ~)

COMPOUND WORDS:
- {寄付|きふ}{金|きん} (donation money)
- {寄付|きふ}{者|しゃ} (donor)
- {寄付|きふ}{行為|こうい} (act of donation)

ALTERNATIVE WRITING:
- {寄附|きふ} is also used (same meaning)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {募金|ぼきん}: fundraising, collection
- {献金|けんきん}: contribution (often political)
- {贈与|ぞうよ}: gift, donation (legal term)
